email_conditions: Send to the last known address (email address in rental agreement or later written change of address). Email is deemed delivered when sent. If operator gets an automated message that the email cannot be delivered, operator must then send notice by verified mail, postage prepaid, to the last known address. Verified mail is deemed delivered when deposited with USPS or private delivery service, properly addressed, postage prepaid.
advertising_detail: Newspaper of general circulation in the county; any commercially reasonable manner (deemed so if likely to attract at least three independent bidders in person or online) if no such newspaper in the county or contents valued at $500 or less by operator's experience
online_sale: Statute silent; sale must be commercially reasonable

email_conditions: The sections require a registered letter and posting. Email is not mentioned, and no authority was found that lets email replace the registered letter.
advertising_rule: No ad medium set by statute
advertising_detail: Notice of the sale posted in three public places in the recording district. No newspaper or online advertising requirement appears in AS 34.35.175 or AS 34.35.225.

email_conditions: Email allowed only for first notice of default (§ 33-1704(B)(1)) and towing notice (§ 33-1704(E)); second notice must be first class mail. 'Email' definition includes electronic messages transmitted between networks from which a confirmation of receipt is received. Last known address includes the electronic address in the rental agreement or a later written change of address.
advertising_rule: No ad medium set by statute
advertising_detail: None found in statute text

email_conditions: Occupant must have provided an email address AND given permission to the facility to use it as legal notification for the last known address. Email replaces the mailed occupant default notice only (§ 18-16-407); lienholder notices are by first class mail with certificate of mailing. Notice is deemed delivered when deposited with USPS. Operator must keep copies of notices and return receipts for 6 months after sale/removal.
advertising_detail: One newspaper advertisement in the county where the facility is located, or advertise the sale in any commercially reasonable manner (deemed commercially reasonable if at least 3 independent bidders participate in the sale)
online_sale: Limited: online listing or bidding, sale held at the facility

notice_methods: First-class mail, Verified mail, Certified mail, Email
email_conditions: Only if the rental agreement states lien notices may be sent by email to the occupant and the alternate, AND the occupant signs the rental agreement consenting to email lien notices. Owner must be able to show actual delivery and receipt (electronic signature acknowledgment, evidence occupant opened/viewed/downloaded, logged into a secured application and viewed it, or reply email with delivery path evidence); otherwise must resend by mail as originally specified.
advertising_rule: Newspaper ad, one website ad allowed
advertising_detail: Newspaper of general circulation in the public notice district or county; or one newspaper ad plus one online ad on a website that customarily conducts or advertises online auctions or sales
statute: Cal. Bus. & Prof. Code § 21700 et seq.

email_conditions: Email must go to the last-known email address (provided in the latest rental agreement or later written change of address). If the owner emails notice of a pending sale and gets no response, return receipt, or delivery confirmation from that same address, the owner must send the sale notice by verified mail to the last-known postal address before proceeding with the sale.
advertising_detail: Newspaper (periodical circulating weekly or more often in the facility's county) or any other commercially reasonable manner

notice_methods: In person, Certified mail, Registered mail, Email
email_conditions: Email must include a statement that opening the email is acceptance of the notice. If owner has not received confirmation within 7 days that the occupant opened it, owner must also send by registered or certified mail.
advertising_detail: Print or online newspaper of general circulation in the municipality, or publicly accessible independent website regularly conducting online auctions of personal property. Advertising is permitted ('if the owner wishes') after the notice period expires.

notice_methods: In person, Verified mail, Certified mail, Email
email_conditions: Email only if the rental agreement (original or modified) says email notice is authorized, the occupant affirmatively consents and agrees to report email changes, and that consent is in bold or underlined type. If no electronic receipt establishing delivery is received, owner must send copy by verified or certified mail. Notice presumed delivered when mailed postage prepaid or emailed to the address the occupant provided.
advertising_detail: Print or electronic version of newspaper of general circulation in the county where facility is located, or a publicly accessible independent website that regularly advertises or conducts online auctions or sales of personal property. Ad must include property description, facility address and space number, occupant name, and time, place and manner of sale.

notice_methods: First-class mail, Verified mail, Certified mail
email_conditions: Statute does not authorize email notice; all notices go by certified mail return receipt requested or U.S. mail with certificate of mailing unless otherwise specifically provided. Notices deemed delivered when deposited with USPS postage prepaid.
advertising_detail: Newspaper of general circulation in the jurisdiction where sale is held, or publicly accessible website that regularly advertises or conducts property sales; advertise time, place and terms of sale.

notice_methods: In person, First-class mail, Verified mail, Email, Posting
email_conditions: E-mail to tenant's last known e-mail is allowed. If no response, return receipt, or delivery confirmation is received from that address, owner must also send notice of the sale by first-class mail with certificate of mailing to the last known address before proceeding with the sale.
advertising_detail: Newspaper of general circulation in the area of the facility; OR online sale on a public website that customarily conducts personal property auctions (the statute still requires the newspaper advertisement before a sale). If no newspaper of general circulation exists, post the advertisement at least 10 days before sale in at least 3 conspicuous places in the neighborhood.

notice_methods: In person, Verified mail, Certified mail, Registered mail, Email
email_conditions: E-mail notice allowed. If notice of a pending sale is e-mailed and no nonautomated response or receipt of delivery is received, owner must send the sale notice by verified mail to the occupant's last known address or the designated agent's address before proceeding. Rental agreement must list the addresses for notices.
advertising_detail: Legal organ of the county where the facility is located (the 2013 text also had a posting fallback of 10 days before sale in at least 6 conspicuous places where no newspaper of general circulation exists; that fallback does not appear in the 2019 SB 97 as-passed text reviewed). Online auction on a publicly accessible website counts as public sale. Ad must give a brief general description, facility address and space number, occupant name, and time, place and manner of sale.

email_conditions: E-mail is required, not just allowed: the default notice, lien notice and final demand must go to both the last known e-mail address and the last known postal address.
advertising_detail: Newspaper of general circulation in the judicial district where the sale is held, OR any other commercially reasonable manner provided at least 3 independent bidders participate.

email_conditions: Email is not named in the statute. The statute allows notice 'as provided for in the rental agreement', so email may be usable only if the rental agreement expressly provides for it. Not confirmed by case law; treat as a risk. Without a notice clause, certified mail applies (55-2304).
advertising_rule: No ad medium set by statute
advertising_detail: No advertisement required. The current § 55-2306 (amended 2025) sets no newspaper or other publication rule; the sale must follow the time and place in the notice.

email_conditions: Email presumed delivered when sent and the owner receives a receipt of delivery. If no receipt, notice is presumed delivered only when sent by verified mail to the occupant's last known mailing address. Mail is presumed delivered when deposited with USPS, properly addressed, postage prepaid.
advertising_detail: Newspaper of general circulation where the facility is located; posting in 6 places if no newspaper. Statute text read does not authorize online-only advertising (a different 'commercially reasonable' phrase appeared in a search summary but was not found in the full text read).

email_conditions: No consent requirement in the statute. The address must be the postal or email address the renter gave for the latest rental agreement or in a written change notice (§ 26-3-8-3).
advertising_detail: Publish once before the sale in a newspaper of general circulation in the facility's county, or advertise in any other commercially reasonable manner likely to attract at least three independent bidders. Ad must state the property will be sold to satisfy the lien, the facility address, space designation and renter name, the manner of sale, and the time and place.

email_conditions: Operator and occupant may agree to use email for notices; if they do, they must consent to email for ALL notices and the rental agreement must contain a section outlining each party's rights and duties for email. Email is deemed delivered when sent to the last-known address. If a bounce/undeliverable automated message is received, operator must send notice by hand delivery or verified mail.
advertising_detail: Commercially reasonable manner; no newspaper requirement. Deemed commercially reasonable if likely to attract at least three independent bidders to attend or view the sale in person or online.

email_conditions: Email is sent in addition to first-class mail (not a replacement), and only if occupant has provided an email address to the operator. Notice is deemed delivered when deposited with USPS, properly addressed, postage prepaid. Rental agreements may be delivered electronically if occupant affirmatively agreed in writing.
advertising_detail: Newspaper of general circulation (classified section) or any other commercially reasonable manner (including online). If fewer than 3 independent bidders attend in person or view online, manner is not considered commercially reasonable and sale must be canceled, rescheduled and readvertised.

email_conditions: Last known address includes an email address provided in the latest rental agreement or a later written change of address. First notice may go by regular mail or verified email; second notice must be verified mail or verified email. Deemed delivered when deposited with USPS or when sent by verified email.
advertising_detail: Newspaper of general circulation where sale is held, or any other commercially reasonable manner (deemed so if at least 3 independent bidders participate in or attend).

email_conditions: Email is required alongside verified mail, not instead of it: the notice goes by verified mail to the last known address and by email to the address the lessee provided and listed in the rental agreement, unless it is delivered in person. Since Acts 2026, No. 468 the text message wording is gone from R.S. 9:4759(3). Actual receipt is not required. The statute does not say what to do if the rental agreement lists no email address.
advertising_detail: At least one publication in a newspaper of general circulation where the facility is located, or on a publicly accessible website that regularly advertises or conducts personal property auctions or sales.

email_conditions: Email is permitted only as the companion to verified mail: the notice must go by verified mail AND by first-class mail or email. Email alone is not enough. Notices to the occupant go to the last known address (address in the rental agreement or later written change of address). Deemed delivered when deposited with USPS, properly addressed, postage paid.
advertising_rule: No ad medium set by statute
advertising_detail: None required by statute.

email_conditions: Default notice by email only if the rental agreement (or written change) states in bold that notice may be given by email AND the occupant initialed next to that statement. If sent by email and no reply from the occupant's email or delivery confirmation is received, a second notice must be sent by verified mail to the last known postal address. Same fallback for the notice of sale: if no response/confirmation at least 5 days before sale, promptly send second notice of sale by verified mail. Notices deemed delivered when deposited with USPS/private carrier with postage prepaid, or when sent by email.
advertising_detail: Newspaper of general circulation in the jurisdiction where the sale is held, email, or an online website.

email_conditions: Not addressed. Section 7-210 requires only that persons be 'notified' and refers to 'receipt of the notification'. Email is not mentioned, so whether it works is uncertain.
advertising_detail: Newspaper of general circulation where the sale is to be held. If there is none, post at least 10 days before the sale in not fewer than 6 conspicuous places in the neighborhood of the sale.

email_conditions: Email to the tenant's last known address, which includes an email address provided in the latest rental agreement or a later written change of address (hand delivery, first-class mail, or email). Presumed delivered on transmission to that address. No consent form or delivery receipt required by the act.
advertising_detail: Newspaper of general circulation (print or electronic version) in the area of the facility, or a publicly available website identified in the rental agreement. Fallback is posting in 3 conspicuous places at least 10 days before sale. A single ad may cover multiple tenants.
online_sale: Statute silent; sale must be commercially reasonable

email_conditions: Exclusive email notice requires the occupant's informed written consent; the rental agreement must contain a 12-point bold consent notice with a checkbox set out in the statute; consent may be withdrawn anytime. Owner must obtain an electronic receipt establishing delivery. If delivery cannot be verified, notice must be delivered in person or by verified mail, and the 14 day period does not start until that delivery. Mailed notices go to the email (if consented), the mailing address and any alternate mailing address in the rental agreement, or a more current known address. Mail is presumed delivered on deposit.
advertising_detail: Newspaper of general circulation where the sale is to be held (qualified under chapter 331A); website fallback only if no qualified newspaper. Ad must include general description of goods, name of the person on whose account goods are held, time and place of sale.

email_conditions: Email is an allowed delivery method for the lien notice. If the owner offers email notice, the occupant may elect email-only notice in the rental agreement. If the owner gets an automated undeliverable reply, the notice must be delivered in person or by verified mail.
advertising_detail: Advertise the sale to the highest bidder in any commercially reasonable manner; deemed commercially reasonable if likely to attract at least three independent bidders to attend or view the sale in person or online. The ad must include the facility address, occupant name, and the time, place and manner of sale. No newspaper requirement (struck by HB 1138, 2020).

email_conditions: Last known address is the postal or email address in the latest rental agreement or a later written change of address; occupant may designate one in writing as preferred method, which the operator must use. Notices deemed delivered when deposited with USPS postage prepaid or sent by email.
advertising_detail: Newspaper of general circulation in the jurisdiction where sale is held, in the classified section, stating items will be released for sale. Online sale is allowed as a public sale but newspaper ad is still required by the text.

email_conditions: Only if the renter provided an email address (in rental agreement or later written change). Email deemed delivered on date sent; verified mail deemed delivered when postmarked, properly addressed, postage paid.
advertising_detail: Newspaper of general circulation in the county of sale, or any other commercially reasonable manner; commercially reasonable if sale attended or viewed by at least 3 persons in person or online.
online_sale: Statute silent; sale must be commercially reasonable

email_conditions: The Act authorizes only personal delivery or first-class mail. Email is not mentioned and is not authorized.
advertising_detail: Newspaper of general circulation in the county where the sale is to be held. If there is none, post at least 10 days before the sale in not fewer than six conspicuous places in the neighborhood. Required only for property the landlord reasonably believes is worth $2,000 or more.

email_conditions: Email is permitted 'if available' for the termination notice and the notice of sale. 'Last known address' includes the email address in the latest rental agreement or a written change of address. 'Electronic mail' is defined as a message from which confirmation of receipt is received. For the notice of sale, if sent by email and no confirmation of receipt is received, the owner must also send it by verified mail.
advertising_detail: Newspaper of general circulation in the judicial district where the sale is held, with occupant name, unit number, facility name and address. If no such newspaper, post 10 days before sale in at least six conspicuous places near the sale or on a publicly accessible website.
online_sale: Statute silent; sale must be commercially reasonable

notice_methods: In person, First-class mail, Verified mail, Email
email_conditions: If owner offers email notice, the rental agreement must state in bold that the renter may agree to receive notice by email only, and renter assent must be indicated in the agreement if chosen. Last known address includes the email address in the rental agreement or later written change. Email notice is deemed delivered when properly addressed and sent; mail is deemed delivered when deposited with USPS or another carrier, postage prepaid.
advertising_rule: No ad medium set by statute
advertising_detail: No advertising requirement in the chapter.

email_conditions: Email is permitted for the lien notice. 'Last known address' includes an email address provided by the occupant in the latest rental agreement or a later written change of address. Notice is presumed delivered when deposited with USPS or private delivery service, properly addressed with postage prepaid, or sent by email. If the notice is sent by email and the owner does not receive an electronic receipt establishing delivery to the occupant's email address, the notice is presumed delivered when it is sent by verified mail to the occupant's last known address (so a verified mail fallback is needed in that case). The statute does not require a separate email consent clause.
advertising_detail: Newspaper of general circulation where the self-service storage facility is located; if none, post at least 10 days before the sale in not less than six conspicuous places in the neighborhood of the facility. Online-only advertising is not authorized by the text; the online provision (2A:44-191.1) concerns where the sale is held.

email_conditions: All notices under 48-11-7 go by verified mail or email 'pursuant to the occupant's option at the time of entering into the current rental agreement', so the occupant chooses at move-in. The owner gives written notice by verified mail to the occupant's last known address or by email to the last known electronic address. If the notice goes by email and no response, return receipt or delivery confirmation arrives within three business days, the owner must send a one-time notice by verified mail to the last known address. Last known address means the postal or electronic address the occupant provided for the latest rental agreement or in a later written or electronic change notice.
advertising_detail: Newspaper of general circulation in the county where the facility is located. If there is none, post at least 10 days before the sale in at least six conspicuous places in the neighborhood of the facility. Online-only advertising is not authorized.

notice_methods: In person, Verified mail, Certified mail, Registered mail, Email
email_conditions: Email notice is effective only if (i) the occupancy agreement states the occupant consented to receive late or lien notices by email and (ii) the occupant provided the email address in at least two locations within the occupancy agreement. Email is not a stand-alone method: it must be sent together with verified mail. The agreement must carry the notice that the occupant may choose email contact for legal matters by giving the email address in at least two locations. Notice is deemed delivered when properly addressed to the last known address and either sent by registered, certified or verified mail with evidence of mailing received, or sent by email and a non-automated response or a delivery receipt is received. Verified mail includes first class mailing with certificate of mailing.
advertising_rule: No ad medium set by statute
advertising_detail: The statute requires the notice to say the goods will be advertised but does not state where or how to advertise; the sale must be commercially reasonable.
online_sale: Statute silent; sale must be commercially reasonable

email_conditions: Email is allowed for both the 44A-43(b)(2) lien notice and the 44A-43(c)(1) sale notice only if the occupant made an election in the rental agreement to receive notice by email, and the address is verified (verified by any reasonable means as a working address). Email notice is presumed delivered when sent. Last known address includes an email address provided in the latest rental agreement or later written change.
advertising_detail: Newspaper of general circulation in the county where sale is held, or any other commercially reasonable manner; deemed commercially reasonable if at least 3 independent bidders attend the sale and it is consistent with G.S. 25-9-627.

email_conditions: Email is permitted without any election or verification requirement; deemed delivered when sent to the occupant's last-known electronic mail address (the address in the latest rental agreement or later written change of address). Mail is deemed delivered when deposited, properly addressed with postage prepaid.
advertising_detail: Advertise time, place and terms of sale in a commercially reasonable manner; deemed satisfied if at least 3 independent bidders attend the sale in person or online.
online_sale: Statute silent; sale must be commercially reasonable

notice_methods: In person, First-class mail, Certified mail, Email
email_conditions: Email to the occupant only if (i) the occupant agreed to receive notice by email and provided an email address in the original agreement or a later amendment, and (ii) the owner sends it so as to establish by response or return receipt that it was delivered. Deemed delivered when the owner receives a response or return receipt. If delivery cannot be established, the owner must use another authorized method. Mail is deemed delivered when deposited with USPS or private carrier, properly addressed with postage prepaid.
advertising_detail: Newspaper of general circulation in the county where the facility is located, or any other commercially reasonable manner (deemed so if at least 3 independent bidders register for, view or attend). Ad must include a general description of the property, occupant's name and last known address, facility street address, and the time, place and manner of sale.

email_conditions: Email notice only if mutually agreed between owner and occupant in the rental agreement or addendum. Presumed delivered when sent, properly addressed, and not returned as unavailable; if returned as unavailable, notice must be given by verified mail. Verified mail is presumed delivered when deposited with USPS or private carrier, properly addressed, postage prepaid.
advertising_detail: One publication in a newspaper of general circulation in the county where the facility is located (online-only advertising is not provided for as a substitute); posting in 6 conspicuous places plus one publication in an adjoining-county legal newspaper if no local newspaper.

notice_methods: Verified mail, Certified mail, Registered mail, Email
email_conditions: Email to last known address (an email address given in the latest rental agreement or a later written change of address) is permitted. Delivery is presumed if the owner has a record or other evidence that notice was sent to an email address the occupant designated in the rental agreement for receiving email. Mail is presumed delivered when properly addressed, postage prepaid, and deposited with USPS.
advertising_detail: Newspaper of general circulation in the city or county where the facility is located; if none, post in at least 6 conspicuous places in the neighborhood. Ad lists facility address, space number if any, occupant name, and time, place and manner of sale. No ad needed if owner reasonably values the property at $1,000 or less.
online_sale: Limited: online listing or bidding, sale held at the facility

notice_methods: In person, Verified mail, Certified mail, Email
email_conditions: Email only if (i) the original rental agreement or a later modification informs the occupant that email notice is an authorized means, (ii) the occupant affirmatively consents to electronic contact and agrees to promptly report email changes, and (iii) that consent is printed in bold type or underlined in the rental agreement. Notice is presumed served when deposited with USPS or private carrier, properly addressed, postage prepaid, or when emailed to the address provided by the occupant.
advertising_rule: Newspaper ad, one website ad allowed
advertising_detail: Newspaper of general circulation serving the area twice, or once in the newspaper plus once on a publicly accessible website that regularly advertises or conducts online sales of personal property. A redundant website ad may be run alongside a newspaper ad and counts if the newspaper fails to publish timely; the owner must keep a copy and proof of purchase for one year. Ad states that contents will be sold to satisfy the lien, facility address, space number and occupant name, and time, place and manner of sale.

email_conditions: Verified electronic mail is allowed for both notices. Last known address includes an email address provided in the latest rental agreement or later written change of address. 'Verified mail' is defined as USPS method (or email) providing evidence of mailing; 'verified email' itself is not separately defined.
advertising_detail: Publicly accessible website identified in the rental agreement or later notice; or in lieu, newspaper of general circulation in the city or town where the facility is located. Must include name of person on whose account stored and time and place of sale.

notice_methods: In person, First-class mail, Verified mail, Certified mail, Email
email_conditions: Occupant chooses mail or email notice by signing in the rental agreement (mandatory language); choosing email waives personal service or mail of default notices. Email presumed delivered when sent to last known address and a confirmation of receipt is received. Changes of preference must be in writing by first class mail or hand delivery.
advertising_detail: Newspaper of general circulation where the facility is located, after the 50-day default period expires. Contents: brief description of property, facility address and occupant name, time, place, and manner of sale.

email_conditions: Only if email is provided in the rental agreement. Deemed delivered when sent to the last known email address. Mail deemed delivered when deposited with USPS properly addressed with postage prepaid.
advertising_detail: Newspaper of general circulation where the facility is located, after notice period expires. Contents: description, facility address, space number, occupant name, time, place, and manner of sale. If no newspaper, post 10 days before sale in 6 conspicuous places in the neighborhood.

email_conditions: No special conditions. 'Last known address' includes the street address, P.O. box, or email address provided in the latest rental agreement or a later written change of address from the occupant.
advertising_detail: Advertise sale in a commercially reasonable manner; deemed commercially reasonable if at least 3 potential bidders participate in the sale at the advertised time and place. Newspaper publication one time before the sale is allowed but not mandatory. Ad content is specified.

email_conditions: Email notice is permitted only if the written rental agreement has language underlined or in conspicuous bold print that notice may be given by email if the tenant elects to provide an email address. Sent to last known email address in the rental agreement or later written notice from tenant.
advertising_detail: Newspaper of general circulation in the county; if none, post at the facility plus at least 5 other conspicuous locations nearby. Notice contents listed in 59.044(a).

notice_methods: In person, Verified mail, Certified mail, Email
email_conditions: If emailed and no response, return receipt, or delivery confirmation is received within 3 business days, owner must deliver in person or by certified mail. Last known email address is the one in the rental agreement or a later written change of address. Notice is presumed delivered when deposited with USPS properly addressed with postage prepaid.
advertising_detail: After the notice period expires, publish once in a newspaper of general circulation in the county where the facility is located; ad contents specified. Exempt if notice was emailed with response or return receipt, or sent by certified mail with evidence.

notice_methods: First-class mail, Verified mail, Certified mail, Email
email_conditions: Occupant may elect email notice only by indicating the election in the rental agreement (§ 3903(a)(5)(D)). If the second notice goes by email and no response, return receipt or delivery confirmation comes from the same address within 2 days, the owner must, before sale, resend by certified mail or first-class mail with certificate of mailing. Email is delivered when properly addressed and sent; mail is delivered when deposited with USPS.
advertising_detail: Advertise sale in print or electronic version of a newspaper of general circulation where the facility is located; ad must include general description, facility address, space number if any, occupant name, and time, place and manner of sale. Town hall posting if no newspaper. Commercially reasonable alternative allowed.

notice_methods: First-class mail, Verified mail, Certified mail, Email
email_conditions: Electronic notice allowed only if expressly provided for in the rental agreement; sender must retain sufficient proof of electronic delivery (electronic receipt, fax confirmation, or certificate of service). Last known address includes an email address provided in the rental agreement or later written change. Notice presumed delivered when deposited with USPS properly addressed with postage prepaid, or sent electronically with retained proof; sender bears burden in a dispute.
advertising_rule: No ad medium set by statute
advertising_detail: None. The Virginia statute does not require advertisement of the sale.

notice_methods: In person, First-class mail, Verified mail, Email
email_conditions: Email may be used only if (a) occupant expressly agrees, (b) rental agreement states in bold type that notices will be given by email, (c) owner gives the occupant the sending email address and tells the occupant to allow it through filters, and (d) owner announces any change of sending address in advance. For the final notice, if emailed and no reply or receipt of delivery is received, the owner must also send a second notice by verified mail to the last known postal address.
advertising_rule: No ad medium set by statute
advertising_detail: None. No newspaper or other advertisement of the sale is required. Sale must be a public sale; with five or more bidders in attendance, proceeds are deemed commercially reasonable.

notice_methods: In person, Verified mail, Email, Text message
email_conditions: Email or text notice of default is allowed only if the rental agreement specifies in bold type that notice may be given by email or text AND the occupant initialed next to that statement. If the operator sends by email or text and gets no response, return receipt or delivery confirmation, it must then send the notice by hand delivery or verified mail to the last known postal address. Notice is deemed delivered when deposited with USPS or a private delivery service with postage prepaid, or when sent by email to the last known email address. Last known address includes the email address in the rental agreement or a later written change of address.
advertising_detail: Advertise time, place and terms of sale in a newspaper of general circulation in the jurisdiction where the sale is to be held, by email, or on an online website. Email and online website advertising are not allowed unless the occupant initialed the rental agreement statement. Rental agreement must tell the occupant that advertising may be by newspaper, email or text, or online website.

email_conditions: Email may be used for the 1st notice, 2nd notice, or a postponement notice only if the operator uses a service that provides confirmation of receipt and actually receives confirmation that the notice was received; otherwise the operator must send by regular mail (1st notice) or verified mail (2nd notice). Mail notice is presumed delivered when deposited with USPS, properly addressed to the last-known address with postage prepaid. Last-known address is from the most recent rental agreement or later written change of address.
advertising_detail: Publish once in a newspaper of general circulation where the self-service storage facility or unit is located, with a brief general description of the property, the facility address (or operator address for a unit) and the lessee name. If a physical sale is postponed for inclement weather (up to 14 days), a new ad with the original date and reason is required, plus a notice at least 5 days before the new date by regular mail or confirmed email.

email_conditions: Statute requires certified mail, return receipt requested, to the last known address; no electronic notice provision found.
advertising_rule: No ad medium set by statute
advertising_detail: Under the incorporated warehouse procedure (34.1-7-210(b)(v)): newspaper of general circulation where the sale is to be held, with goods description, name of the person on whose account held, and time and place; if no newspaper, post in six conspicuous places at least 10 days before sale. Applies when enforcing under 29-7-105(h); 29-7-105(b) itself only requires a commercially reasonable time, place and terms.
online_sale: Statute silent; sale must be commercially reasonable
